name: Vi
description: Voice set for Warring Kingdoms Vi (skin 5): a ferocious, ruthless enforcer of a ruler's will who thrills at any challenge, her jade gauntlets hitting like cannons. Decrees, banners, sieges, campaigns and warlords. Builds on vi-original.json.

messages.message: {momentTitle} is {voteDiff} down. The walls are cracking. Summon the banners.
Thirty or more behind. Beat the war drums until every province hears.
{momentTitle} trails by {voteDiff}. Send riders to every garrison you know.
Fifteen-odd short. A bruised flank, not a lost war.
Down {voteDiff}. Bring a fellow soldier. Even a general needs an army. Barely.
{voteDiff} behind. A few good charges and the field is level.
Down {voteDiff}. A skirmish gap. Close it before the gates shut.
Dead level. One decree tips the war. Issue it.
One vote apart. Stop watching from the ramparts and charge.
{voteDiff} votes apart. Armies are trembling. Call more banners.
{voteDiff} votes between them. This siege goes down to the last gate.
{momentTitle} commands {userPct}% of the field. A throne is in sight.
{userPct}% and still advancing. Don't sound the retreat.
{userPct}%. The enemy is wavering. Press.
{userPct}% on your pick. We hold the high ground. Keep it.
Up at {userPct}%. Glorious. Now take the citadel.
{momentTitle} was {voteDiff} down and just took the lead. A flank no one saw.
{voteDiff} behind, now ahead. The reserve cavalry arrived.
Hauled out of a {voteDiff} rout. The drums went silent in awe.
{momentTitle} was losing the war. Now it holds the field.
{momentTitle} just pulled ahead. The strategists are furious.

messages: {username} voted with you on {momentTitle}. Two banners, one march.
{username} raised the same standard for {momentTitle}. Strong allegiance.
{username} agrees with you. Record it in the annals. Rare.
Same pick as {username}. Fine strategic minds.
{username} sided with {momentTitle}. Keen eye for the front.
{username} chose the same. A new soldier in your ranks.
{username} is on your side of {momentTitle}. Give them a place at the war council.
{username} made the same call. No negotiations needed.
{username} voted {momentTitle}. Welcome to the army.
details: Add them to the muster roll.

messages: {username} voted {theirMoment} against {yourMoment}. Enemy colours. Good.
{username} picked {theirMoment}. Opposing banners. Let's see who breaks first.
{username} marched the opposite way on {yourMoment}. Wrong, but bold.
{username} voted against you. A challenger. I was bored of easy fights.
{username} took {theirMoment}. Rash. Foolish. Rash in a good way.
{username} stands against {yourMoment}. Fine. Meet on the field.
{username} disagrees on {yourMoment}. The battle count will tell.
{username} voted the other way. They'll be sending envoys for peace.
details: Every general misjudges a battle once.
Don't take it personally. Or sharpen your blade on it.
A rival keeps the gauntlets heavy.
At least it's an honest war.

messages: Ten in a row with {username}. That's no chance, that's a sworn oath.
{username} and you, ten matches, same call each time. A flawless alliance.
Ten straight with {username}. I'd march behind you two anywhere.
A ten-match run with {username}. A formation no one can break.
Ten for ten with {username}. Impressive. I won't bow. Maybe a nod.
{streakCount} matches with {username}. That's beyond an alliance, that's a dynasty.
{streakCount} in a row with {username}. I'd follow you both through any pass.
{streakCount} straight picks with {username}. Absurd. Gloriously absurd.
A {streakCount}-match run with {username}. Scribes will write it down.
{streakCount} with {username}. Two rulers of the same realm.
details: A pair for the history scrolls.

messages: Ten matches against {username}. That's a standing war now.
{username} has opposed you ten times running. They really loathe your strategy.
Ten in a row opposite {username}. Neither army will pull back.
A ten-match run against {username}. Stubborn warlords, both.
Ten times at odds with {username}. I'd buy a seat on the ramparts to watch.
{streakCount} against {username}. That's not a rivalry, that's a century of war.
{streakCount} in a row opposite {username}. Neither of you cedes a mile.
{streakCount} straight disputes with {username}. Stubborn is too mild a word.
A {streakCount}-match feud with {username}. Someone summon the emperor.
{streakCount} against {username}. I respect it. Go rest at the barracks.
details: Neither of you is lowering a banner.
Glad I'm not between your armies.
The scribes ran out of ink.

messages: {matchTitle} ends in {timeLeft} and your banner isn't raised. March.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. No decree from you. Issue one.
{matchTitle} falls in {timeLeft}. Your seal is the missing one.
{timeLeft} left on {matchTitle}. Forced march.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. Don't make me drag you onto the field.
Only {timeLeft} until {matchTitle} ends. Your camp has gone quiet.
{matchTitle} closes in {timeLeft}. The gates are swinging shut.
{timeLeft} left. Charge.
Final horn on {matchTitle}. {timeLeft}. Commit.
{matchCount} battles without your seal are about to end. The first closes in {timeLeft}.
{matchCount} unvoted battles and the horns are sounding. The nearest has {timeLeft} left.
No votes on {matchTitle}. Someone take the first gate. Don't dither.
{moment1} against {moment2} and not one charge. I'll wait. Barely.
New battle, zero votes. Be the first across the bridge.
{matchTitle} is undefended. Claim it.
{totalVotes} vote{votesPlural}. A thin army.
Barely a soldier on this field. Fix that.
Turnout's meagre. Come on, fill the ranks.
No banners raised here. Someone should raise one.
details: Every seal counts on a bare field.

messages: {matchTitle} is tied and you haven't voted. Choose your banner.
Dead even on {matchTitle}. One decree ends the siege.
Stalemate. Someone has to break the line. Be someone.
{moment1} and {moment2}, locked at the walls. Choose.
Still tied and the sun's setting on the walls. One chance to strike.
Level with the horns nearly done. Vote.
Tied, and the gates are closing. Don't sit this one out.
Round {round} is open. {matchCount} new battles to fight. March.
{matchCount} matches just opened in round {round}. The campaign resumes.
Round {round} is live, {matchCount} battles deep.
New round. {matchCount} matches. Choose your fronts.
Round {round}: {matchCount} battles awaiting your seal.
{momentTitle} won. Victory.
{momentTitle} is through. Sound the horns.
{momentTitle} took the field. Deserved.
{momentTitle} won, and the whole realm shook.
{momentTitle} advances. A clean campaign.
{momentTitle} marches on. Banners high.
{momentTitle} lost. That one cost a province.
{momentTitle} is out. Not the campaign we planned.
{momentTitle} didn't make it. Tend the wounded.
{momentTitle} fell fighting. Honour.
{momentTitle} is out. Fall back to the fortress and regroup.
{momentTitle} lost this round. A hard defeat. Not the war.
{momentTitle} was routed. We march on another front.
Still deciding? Quit pacing the tent and choose.
Don't overthink it. Pick and charge.
They're all worth a duel. Trust your fists.
You've scouted from the hill long enough. Descend.
details: No wrong banner. A few poor ones.

messages: Welcome to the war camp. {liveCount} matches are open. Pick one.
New recruit? {liveCount} matches are live. Fall in.
You're early. {liveCount} matches need soldiers.
{liveCount} matches open. Choose your front.
Welcome. {liveCount} matches. Keep your guard up.
Day two. You returned to camp. Good.
Two days running. Nice.
Back for day two. I noticed.
{days} days away. Did you desert?
After {days} days you're back. Better late than court-martialled.
{days} days. Thought you'd fallen in battle. Glad you didn't.
{days} days away. The map has changed.
You returned. Good.
Welcome back. Let's fight.
Back already. Eager.
Hey. The front's waiting.
First banner raised. Welcome to the war.
You picked a side. First battle joined.
Five votes. Your gauntlets are warming.
Five. Not a green recruit any more.
Ten votes. The army knows your banner.
Ten. You belong in these ranks.
details: A veteran of the front. +{xp} XP

messages: Twenty-five votes. Your war cry carries.
Twenty-five. The whole realm hears you.
Fifty votes. Deep in the campaign now.
Fifty. You truly care. Good soldier.
A hundred votes. Poets will sing of you.
One hundred. Honestly fearsome. Don't tell the generals.
details: Earned by steel and sweat. +{xp} XP
A hundred. The court kneels. +{xp} XP

messages: Three days running. A campaign is forming.
Three straight days. Steady marching.
details: Three dawns on the march. +{xp} XP

messages: A full week. That's real endurance.
Seven days on the march. Strong legs indeed.
details: A week without breaking ranks. +{xp} XP

messages: Two weeks. You never rest.
Fourteen days. Whoa.
details: Two weeks, no missed muster. +{xp} XP

messages: Thirty days. Truly, I'm grateful. Don't repeat that.
A month on campaign. That means something.
details: Thirty days of iron will. +{xp} XP
A full month under the banner. +{xp} XP

messages: Five underdogs. You back the besieged.
Five outmatched sides. A soldier after my own heart.
Fifteen underdogs. You defend the doomed fortress on purpose.
Fifteen. You don't take orders from the crowd.
Thirty underdogs. No spy can read your plans.
Thirty. The outmatched is your whole doctrine.
details: Thirty seals for the side behind. +{xp} XP

messages: First on the field five times. Eager.
Five times you reached the battle before the others.
details: You strike before the horns finish. +{xp} XP
Five seals before the host arrives. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen battles with you at the spearhead. Valiant.
Always the first rider out.
details: Fifteen seals before the rest. +{xp} XP
Ahead of the whole army. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten close matches. You thrive in a stalemate.
Another blade-edge finish. Your nerve is jade.
Twenty-five close matches. Your seal keeps deciding the war.
You've broken more than one siege.
Five times you held with the weaker host. Loyal. Approved.
You never desert a side that's falling. Respect.
details: Faith in a late charge. +{xp} XP

messages: Same moment, three times. Someone has a favoured fortress.
That one again? It must hold good ground.
Five votes for the same moment. That's oath-sworn.
You won't abandon that one. Fair.
Ten votes on the same moment. That's an obsession, soldier.
Ten times, same pick. I won't tell the court. Much.
details: Devoted. Or besieged by it. +{xp} XP

messages: Two rounds. You're staying for the whole campaign.
Round two and you're still fighting. Good.
details: Stay for the next front. +{xp} XP

messages: Four rounds. The land is growing dark with smoke.
Deep in the bracket. Battles bite harder from here.
Six rounds. You stayed till the final gate.
All the way. You never left the war.
details: First march to final battle. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten matches. You've scouted every province.
Ten different matches. Thorough recon. Nice.
Twenty-five matches. You've crossed every border.
Twenty-five. Not a valley unmapped.
Fifty matches. That's not a visit, that's a lifetime of war.
Fifty. You know this realm better than its generals.
Five in one sitting. A long campaign.
Five back to back. Water the horses.
Ten in a single push. Rest the horses.
Ten at one stretch. That's stamina.
Voting this late? Night watch or restless?
Middle of the night. Devotion, or you're fighting in the dark too.
You told others. Thanks, comrade.
Five shares. More soldiers, more strength.
details: Thanks for raising more levies. +{xp} XP

messages: Fifteen shares. You're practically a general.
Fifteen. You keep gathering the host. Love it.
You were here before the first battle. Founding member, forever.
One of the first thousand. No decree can strike that out.
details: No one's tearing that banner down. +{xp} XP

messages: New rank. Hard-won.
Promoted. Don't strut.
Achievement unlocked: {name}. A fine honour.
Another honour for the hall: {name}.
{rank}. Well earned.
You put in the marches and it shows.
Ten underdogs. Reckless. Sadly, it runs in the family.
Ten hopeless-looking sides. You fear no odds.
details: Ten pledges to the outmatched. +{xp} XP
Long shots are your battles. +{xp} XP

messages: Ten tight ones beside Cait. Your nerve is jade.
Ten tight finishes. She'd be proud. I'm not smiling.
A week with Cait. Her discipline's wearing off on you.
A week and you never missed. Fine marksmanship.
details: A week at her side. +{xp} XP

messages: You broke the tie. Decisive strike.
Deadlocked, and you broke it. Respect.
details: The seal that ended the siege. +{xp} XP

messages: Vi's your champion now. Stay behind my gauntlets.
Vi covers your flank. Don't make her regret it.

upcoming: Not open yet. The gates are shut.
Voting hasn't started. I'll sound the horn when it does.
prevote: Two moments, one decree. Study both before you rule.
Scout them both before you choose. No peeking at the host.
I won't tell you which banner. Your war.
Go with your fists. They're usually right.
prevote-empty: No votes yet. Raise the first banner.
closing-24h: Under a day left and no seal from you. March.
closing-3h: Light's fading. Vote before the gates shut.
voted-early: You voted early with barely anyone around. First across the bridge.
Hardly a vote in and you charged. Bold.
voted-ahead: Your pick's ahead. Nice. The battle isn't over.
{pct}% with you. The host is following.
A lead's a lead. Keep your guard up.
voted-close: That's close. Too close. My jade gauntlets are creaking.
Razor-thin. One more seal flips it. Send a rider.
Neck and neck. Your pick needs reinforcements.
voted-tied: Equal strength on both walls. Nobody blinks.
A perfect tie. Maddening. Also thrilling.
voted-behind: You're trailing. That doesn't make you foolish.
{pick} is trailing. Underdog. My favourite fight.
They lead. You aren't wrong, merely outnumbered.
Down by {diff} points. Call the provinces. Fill the field.
Most marched the other way. That proves nothing.
closed-lost: Your pick lost. It stings. Tend your wounds.
It didn't make it. Happens. Next front.
{pick} is out. Sorry. It was a worthy fight.
closed-unvoted: Voting's closed and you missed this battle. More wars coming.
Match is over. {winner} took it. Next time, charge first.

first-vote: First vote. Welcome. Every soldier's first strike is clumsy.
That's your first. It gets easier. I swear.
You're in the army now. Welcome.
streak: {streak} days running. I see you reporting.
You keep returning to the ranks. Nice.
underdog: You raised the banner no one else did. I saw.
The outmatched side. That takes iron nerve.
early: Early. You hit the field before the host.
A quiet field so far. Your seal rings like a gong.
close: That seal just shifted things. It's tight.
Razor-thin. One more soldier flips it.
behind: {pick} is behind. Behind isn't broken. Bring the army.
Not in front yet. The war's still on.
Pushed back, not broken. Big difference.
ahead: {pick} is ahead. Don't sleep. Fronts shift.
default: Understood. I'll swallow my objection. For now.
Vote's in. Plenty more battles ahead.

live-fresh: {unvoted} matches and no seals yet. Start with the battle that stirs your blood.
Every front's open. Pick. I won't rush you. Much.
{unvoted} still open. No hurry. Fine, some hurry.
live-some: The march has started. {unvoted} fronts still wait.
Good opening. The rest won't fight themselves.
live-few: Only {unvoted} left. Finish before the gates close.
live-one: Last battle. Don't let it slip.
One match between you and a full campaign.
live-closing: Some of these end in {timeLeft}. {unvoted} still lack your seal.
The horn is nearly sounding. Move.
live-done: You voted in everything. Look at you. Go survey the bracket.
Nothing left on your orders. Come back when the next round opens.
live-none: Nothing's live right now. It'll resume. Study the bracket meanwhile.
No matches open. My fists itch as much as yours.
brackets-groups: Groups first. Top two from each march on. The rest go home.
All begin in a group. Few leave it with their banners intact.
Eye the standings. They swing fast.
brackets-knockout-soon: Knockouts approach. Two per group keep their banners.
The knockout stage isn't declared. The groups still fight.
Wait. The knockout rises when the groups fall quiet.
brackets-knockout-live: Knockouts now. Lose once and you're banished.
One defeat ends it. No retreat to regroup.
Every battle bites harder now. Choose carefully.
brackets-bracket: Round on round. One defeat and your banner falls.
Read the war map. Fewer banners every round.
Every line here is a battle someone voted on.
brackets-complete: That's the cup complete. Thanks for fighting beside me.
It's over. Good war. I'll miss the front.
We have a champion. Worth every march.
brackets-empty: No bracket yet. Nothing's been mapped.
Empty. The borders haven't been drawn. Soon.
Empty plains for now. Return soon.

invite: {a} or {b}. One decree decides it. Choose.
Two fortresses, one pick: {a} against {b}. Cast your vote.
{a} versus {b}. Join the war and tell me what you think.
voted: I chose {pick} over {other}. Whose colours do you fly?
{pick} gets my seal over {other}. Challenge me.
I chose {pick} over {other}. Think I misjudged the field?
early: One of the first votes on {pick} against {other}. We need more soldiers.
I sealed {pick} over {other} ahead of the rest. Stamp yours beside it.
{pick} versus {other}, barely any votes yet. Yours would strike deep.
tied: {pick} and {other} are level. One decree settles it.
{pick} and {other} are inseparable. Your seal parts them.
nailbiter: {pick} and {other} are {voteDiff} votes apart. Every seal counts now.
{voteDiff} votes lie between {pick} and {other}. Stamp yours.
{voteDiff} stand between {pick} and {other}. Either may win the field.
losing-close: {pick} is {voteDiff} behind {other}. A few seals flip it.
{pick} is {voteDiff} short of {other}, yet the fortress stands. Reinforce it.
losing-bad: {pick} is behind {other} by {voteDiff}. It needs the army.
{voteDiff} under {other}. {pick} merits a nobler fate. Vote.
{pick} is losing to {other} by {voteDiff}. Let's turn the war.
winning-close: {pick} leads {other} at {pct}%, but barely. Help it hold the line.
dominating: {pick} leads {other} with {pct}%. Come see the glory.
{pick} leads {other} by a mile, {pct}%. Add your seal.
